owner_decision_ref: owner ruling (C) 2026-11-17: SBL.SourceAdjudication@1 must be verifiable as signed by the original SBL Reader; a reader_identity string or an authority_ref path with no verifiable original signature is UNVERIFIED
note: No public key has been published by the original SBL PIPD Reader. Until the owner enrolls one here, EVERY adjudication record is UNVERIFIED - including one that names the reader correctly.
